results.title: How long do you store my organization's data?
results.content:
| Service/policy | Retention or deletion facts stated on this page |
|---|---|
| Anthropic API | Inputs and outputs are automatically deleted from Anthropic’s backend within **30 days of receipt or generation**, except when a service has longer retention under the customer’s control (for example, Files API), the parties have agreed otherwise (for example, a zero data retention agreement), longer retention is needed to enforce the Usage Policy, or retention is required by law. |
| Usage Policy violations | If a chat is flagged by automated trust and safety systems as violating the Usage Policy, inputs and outputs may be retained for **up to 2 years**, and trust and safety classification scores for **up to 7 years**. Chats or sessions may also be retained as required by law or as necessary to combat Usage Policy violations. If the contract permits, organization data may be anonymized for research or statistical purposes and retained longer. |
| Sentry Team | No Sentry Team error-retention information is stated on this page. |
| Resend | No email-log-retention information is stated on this page. |
| Stripe | No information about redaction or mandatory payment-record retention is stated on this page. |
| Supabase | No information about backup limits or free-plan backup availability is stated on this page. |

results.title: Data Retention Periods - Sentry Docs
results.content:
| Service | Facts stated on this page |
|---|---|
| Anthropic API | Input/output retention of 30 days and Usage Policy/legal exceptions are not stated. |
| Sentry | Team-plan error data is retained for **90 days**. Retention is set when data is ingested, based on the plan at that time; plan upgrades or downgrades affect new data only, and existing data keeps its original retention period. When data reaches the end of its retention period, it can no longer be accessed. |
| Resend | Email log retention of 30 days is not stated. |
| Stripe | Redaction and mandatory payment-record retention are not stated. |
| Supabase | Backup limits and free-plan backup availability are not stated. |

results.title: What are Resend account quotas and limits?
results.content:
| Service | Retention, deletion, or related policy facts stated on this page |
|---|---|
| Resend | Email data is retained for **30 days** on Free, Pro, and Scale plans. This includes email content and metadata, delivery status and events, and logs and metrics. Enterprise plans have flexible data-retention options; contact support about custom requirements. The page suggests storing webhook events in your own database for access to historical data beyond 30 days. It does not specify a deletion process. |
| Anthropic API | Not stated on this page. |
| Sentry | Not stated on this page. |
| Stripe | Not stated on this page. |
| Supabase | Not stated on this page.

results.title: Handling customer deletion requests
results.content:
| Service | Facts stated on this page |
|---|---|
| **Stripe** | **Redaction** permanently removes personal data from view, making the redacted object’s data inaccessible in the Dashboard and API. Stripe recommends redaction jobs for consumer data deletion requests; jobs can identify multiple related objects. **Deletion** is available for some features; delete API endpoints act only on the specified object. Stripe may retain data after redaction when legally required by local authorities, and may require an object’s usage to be finalized or a risk period to end first. Transactions don’t support deletion and can only be redacted after **90 days**. The Redaction API doesn’t support invoice redactions because issued invoices can be subject to tax-integrity and record-retention requirements. Invoice handling depends on status: delete the sandbox if the invoice belongs to one; void finalized or subscription invoices; delete one-off invoices that aren’t finalized. |
| **Anthropic API** | The page does not state input/output retention periods or Usage Policy/legal exceptions. |
| **Sentry Team** | The page does not state error-retention periods. |
| **Resend** | The page does not state email-log retention periods. |
| **Supabase** | The page does not state backup limits or whether backups are available on the free plan. |

results.title: Database Backups | Supabase Docs
results.content:
| Service | Retention, deletion, or availability facts stated on the page |
|---|---|
| Supabase | Pro, Team, and Enterprise projects are automatically backed up daily. Pro projects can access the last **7 days** of daily backups; Team, **14 days**; Enterprise, **up to 30 days**. The page recommends that free-tier projects regularly export data with the Supabase CLI `db dump` command and maintain off-site backups; it does not state that free-tier projects receive automatic daily backups. Deleting a project permanently removes all associated data, including backups stored in S3, and is irreversible. With PITR enabled, daily backups stop; PITR recovery retention options listed are **7, 14, or 28 days**. |
| Anthropic API | Retention and Usage Policy/legal-exception details are not present in the supplied page. |
| Sentry | Team error-retention details are not present in the supplied page. |
| Resend | Email-log retention details are not present in the supplied page. |
| Stripe | Redaction and mandatory payment-record details are not present in the supplied page. |
